title: An out-of-range core value in an upload is refused alone on both clients
evidence: Done 2026-11-26, Brad's decision (US-13 AC27): packages/health-core/src/upload-candidates.ts candidates gives `refused` for a selected core value with a fault and `blocks` for held text alone; upload-list.ts status `refused`; upload-view.ts saveBlockers reads `blocks`, so Save writes the rest and the write refuses that row (bulkAppendValues per row). The iPhone draws the same view (UploadPage save.enabled) and takes it with its next engine release; no Swift change. Tests: upload-list.per-row-refusal.test.ts and the list-view property (L4, B). Found by Fable 2026-11-11
